notes.title: SANDCASTLE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43645087/01ee61c6449020e279046b673891138c292c7b99.png[/img]

Master all the twists and turns in the new Sandcastle map. Strategically place cannons to inflict maximum damage: who knows what's waiting around the corner!

New:
- New Map: Sandcastle
- New Weapon: place cannons to fire at any sharks in range
- More chest quests
- More stats

Fixes:
- Sharks drop items if they take damage
- Tire physics material
- Added 'Restore Purchases' in Settings

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43645087/9f99a450781d56ec1b4592f55ebf7df859872f55.png[/img]

If you love playing SHARKS then buy some skins or get a goldfish pack to show your support. All proceeds go right back into the game: new game modes, customizable items, maps, interactable creatures and objects and multiplayer servers.

Thanks so much for playing and please tell your friends: word of mouth is the best way to get more players in the game!

If you have any feedback or comments, please come chat in the Discord (https://ezone.com/discord). Cheers!

- Simon and Jamie

** Don't forget to wishlist SHARKS on Steam! (thanks - it really helps us out!!) **

notes.title: SHARK SHOP
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43645087/5d49f0f9b7664fa94377332c02b0c56cde0ffc2b.png[/img]

Release Notes - v0.1.19 - "SHARK SHOP"

There's now a shark shop where you can spend your goldfish to unlock new cosmetic items. Items are refreshed every half-hour, so make sure you come back often to see what's available.

New:
- Shark Shop: new items available every half-hour
- Goldfish Pack: get more goldfish to unlock rare items
- More unlockable skins and hats
- Reward Chests: refresh way more often
- Biteable activation levers
- Sharks bite cooldown reduced for food (faster biting!)
- Bite tracker: how long can you bite and hold on to objects
- Challenges: Bite and hold objects to complete
- Biting toxic items causes damage (but not to zombies)

Fixes:
- Bite cooldown for other sharks tweaked
- Jellyfish slow rise fixed
- Crab collider tweaked
- Pufferfish tweaks
- Menu layout fixes

If you love playing SHARKS then buy some skins or get a goldfish pack to show your support. All proceeds go right back into the game: new game modes, customizable items, maps, interactable creatures and objects and multiplayer servers.

Thanks so much for playing and please tell your friends: word of mouth is the best way to get more players in the game!

If you have any feedback or comments, please come chat in the Discord (https://ezone.com/discord). Cheers!

- Simon and Jamie

** Don't forget to wishlist SHARKS on Steam! (thanks - it really helps us out!!) **

notes.title: HAPPY HOLIDAYS!
notes.content:
Just in time for the gift giving season we've added PRIZE CODES to SHARKS. Now you can get prize codes from our Discord (and #sharks on your socials) to unlock packs of goldfish plus rare skins and items. See what happens when you find all the presents and get them under the Christmas Tree!

New:
- A new rare prize code added to the Discord!
- Christmas Tree to decorate
- Presents to collect
- Festive toxic red barrels
- More rewards for winning
- Prize codes: check our Discord and #sharks on your socials for free prizes (try GOLD50)
- Limited edition skin: SANTA SUIT
- More Leaderboards: Shark Kills, plus Goldfish, Crabs and Dead Fish Eaten 
- Free Elf Hat (for a limited time!)
- Scuba tank now a biteable and throwable bomb
- Explosions cause chain reactions
- Moveable items react to explosions
- More diver Dad jokes
- Above ocean elements (see if you can access them!)
- Gold Founders Skin for Meta Quest (Steam coming soon)
- Win reward: goldfish spawned near leaderboard - the more you win, the more you get!
- Stats: kills, bites, wins, eaten objects + more
- Online leaderboards and achievements
- Updated menus
- Improved unlocked chest graphics
- Health UI
- HUD always active

Fixes:
- Easier to bite multiplayer objects
- Collision tolerances improved
- Occlusion culling tweaks
- Steam demo update compatible with Meta Quest
- Ghost barrel fixed
- Bigger goldfish
- Improved physics for heavy items
- Shark head collider more accurate
- Cooldown for snap turn
- Play with friends fix
- Fixed shark colliders with biteable objects
- Speed limit on thrown objects
- Meta Destinations fix
- Damage caused by explosions proportional to distance
- Skins purchased outside the game are auto-activated 
- Players outside the map fix
- Tweaked goldfish rewards
- Multiplayer updated (so make sure you're friends update too so you can play on the same servers)
- Multiplayer: game round start bug fix
- Rocket powerup more responsive
- More accurate online player count
- Improved fade-in-out between scenes
- Increased health from eating some fish
- Removed HUD toggle from settings
- drop bitten object if another shark takes it
- option to invert y-axis in settings
- menu tweaks

Don't forget to collect your free gift from us - a special limited edition Elf Hat (while supplies last). If you love playing SHARKS then buy some skins to show your support. All proceeds from skins go right back into the game: new game modes, customizable items, maps, interactable creatures and objects and multiplayer servers.

Thanks so much for playing and please tell your friends: word of mouth is the best way to get more players in the game!

If you have any feedback or comments, please come chat in the Discord (https://ezone.com/discord). Cheers!

- Simon and Jamie

** Don't forget to wishlist SHARKS on Steam! (thanks - it really helps us out!!) **

notes.title: BITE CLUB
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43645087/28a77b65f8afe6acc082229d75da8da1b755be99.png[/img]

Release Notes - v0.1i - "BITE CLUB"

In this release we've added the ability to bite and grab objects so you can move them around the environment. See if you can find the biteable diver (complete with sharkproof wetsuit)!

- Bite objects and drag them around (hold the bite button)
- The heavier the object you are biting/carrying the slower you go
- Throw bitten objects (flick your head and release the bite button)
- Cannonballs explode when they hit something
- Explosions impact nearby sharks
- Treasure Chests: complete quests to unlock rewards
- Unlock more items:  1:10 chance for 'Rare', 1:50 for 'Epic', 1:100 for 'Legendary'

Fixes:
- Changed food outline color to green
- Hazard outline color to red
- Hazards disabled for longer after you hit them

Coming Soon:

- More powerups: invincibility, friggin inlaserbility!
- More items and skins
- More game maps and modes

As we get further along we'll be looking for more feedback regarding gameplay, etc, but for now we just want to make sure everyone can get started and that the multiplayer is solid. If you have any feedback or comments, please direct them to the Discord. Cheers!

- Simon and Jamie

** Don't forget to wishlist SHARKS on Steam! (thanks - it really helps us out!!)**

notes.title: NOW IT GETS PERSONAL
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43645087/dd2f1f51ca7f02b688eb5ebf92c0a9b22ec638e3.png[/img]

In the latest playtest build we've added:

- Items to customize the look of your shark: hats, hair, sunglasses + lots more!
- Gamepad support on desktop version
- Zombie tag: falling trophy visual timer
- Zombie tag: simplified info board
- Mirrors

Everytime you eat the shiny fish in front of the mirror in the singleplayer hub scene you get a random look, so keep chomping until you get the look you want (in future updates you'll be able to mix and match items from your inventory).

Fixes:

- Zombie tag: improved winner selection
- Streamlined network calls
- Light probe fixes in main multiplayer scene

Coming Soon:

- More powerups: invincibility, invisibility, friggin inlaserbility!
- The shop
- More items and skins
- More game maps and modes


As we get further along we'll be looking for more feedback regarding gameplay, etc, but for now we just want to make sure everyone can get started and that the multiplayer is solid. If you have any feedback or comments, please direct them to the Discord. Cheers!

- Simon and Jamie
